entities.summary: Laylah Ali (born 1968) is an American contemporary visual artist. She is known for paintings in which ambiguous race relations are depicted with a graphic clarity and cartoon strip format. She lives in Williamstown, Massachusetts, and is a professor at Williams College. Laylah Ali was a painters & sculptors from Buffalo (b. 1968-05-09, Buffalo). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
